audits.resolution_reason: New label-type/tuple validation does not establish a repair for the separate texture/advertised-domain bypass; retain original source-bound finding.
audits.text:
## 67a09b7f6b66

**Status: reproduced advertised-domain/validator-bypass defect; not patched.**  
Generator SHA-256:
`0b7900f0c0fac180b0c8d4fca84e384a5b40585330b9b0b4cd93ab45a9d65d6d`  
Executed canonical rule hash: `100ba25d6ec9`

`AXES["texture"].valid` advertises `no_dots`, `no_legend`, and `no_walls` as
ordinary valid values, and `generate()` emits each through its explicit override.
All three violate the documented chamber task invariants. Normal `self_check`
correctly reports the missing structure, but passing `meta={"texture": name}`
causes an unconditional early success, so the same invalid grids are accepted.

The supported Racket apply command checked all three exact generated inputs:

| Texture | Normal validator | Validator with texture metadata | Canonical output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `no_dots` | rejects missing color-1 dots | accepts | identity |
| `no_legend` | rejects invalid/missing legend | accepts | identity |
| `no_walls` | rejects missing color-8 walls | accepts | non-identity; much of the undefined lower field becomes color 7 |

Thus the domain contract is self-contradictory: these cases are generator-emitted
and axis-advertised, but not lawful under the task invariants. `no_walls` is not a
safe negative fixture; the canonical rule interprets the malformed structure and
produces a destructive field fill.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/67a09b7f6b66/counterexample.json` — all inputs, actual outputs, conservative no-op rival outputs, override provenance, validator results, hashes, command, and cwd.
- `checks/audit/67a09b7f6b66/degenerate-inputs.json` and `racket-degenerates.json` — exact supported apply inputs/report.
- `checks/audit/67a09b7f6b66/probe.json` — concise case summary.
- `checks/audit/67a09b7f6b66/defect-lint/checks/67a09b7f6b66_before_defect_lint.log` — `texture-domain-overlap` plus four dead helpful textures.

Recommended repair: remove negative fixtures from the ordinary axis domain (or
classify only genuinely lawful edge cases), never let metadata bypass structural
validation, implement or remove the four dead helpful textures, and pin the rule.
